# ClientItemIds.txt - BAPATCH-EXPORTFILTER v1
#
# Item ids the installed CN client can resolve. Every id below is an ItemDBSchema.Id from the
# client's OWN ExcelDB.db; anything outside this list is withheld on the way out (Item_List,
# Account_LoginSync.ItemListResponse.ItemDBs/ExpiryItemDBs, every ParcelResultDB.ItemDBs), so the
# client is never asked to parse an item id its ItemDBSchema does not contain.
#
# Why: the server runs the JP table, which is a superset of the CN client's. 2026-11-19 00:22 an
# Items row with UniqueId=90070000 (a 9e7 banner id that exists only server-side) reached
# /api/item/list; the client's ItemDBSchema lookup failed, the list failed to parse and login looped
# with "同步账号信息时发生错误". The row is NOT deleted - this file only decides what is sent.
#
# Format: one decimal id per line, ascending; '#' comment lines and blank lines are ignored.
# Missing or empty file => the filter disables itself (fail-open, WARN in the log), never a dead game.
#
# source:         work/ba/data/ExcelDB.db
# source table:   ItemDBSchema (column Id)
# source size:    160534528 B
# source md5:     824ce3a8bee2bb5ae36ada1ac95048f1
# source sha256:  c49096aa6fdafee3c7bb4d5293039e1dafe1521c09c033bd25566aefae2cc5a9
# generated:      2026-11-13T22:22:59Z  (source file mtime in UTC, not wall clock, so reruns are byte-identical)
# entries:        1803
#
# Regenerate (rewrites this file):
#   python work\ba\scripts\gen_client_item_ids.py
# Verify the file is current without writing it (exit 1 on drift):
#   python work\ba\scripts\gen_client_item_ids.py --check
#
